title: Chris Moyer, the take-action Chamber leader helping Rowlett businesses grow
excerpt: He leads the Chamber's Ambassadors and Rowlett Young Professionals, and fellow business owner Dave Albert says Chris helped him grow his business this year.
coverAlt: Chris Moyer, front right, takes a selfie with members of Rowlett Young Professionals around a table at Ollie's Azul House.
credit: Chris Moyer (front right, taking the selfie) with Rowlett Young Professionals at Ollie's Azul House.
body:
Every community has a few people who don't just show up, they take action. In Rowlett, one of them is Chris Moyer, and he has become one of the real leaders of the Rowlett Area Chamber.

Chris is a financial advisor, but around town he's best known for what he does for other people's businesses. He heads up the Rowlett Area Chamber's Ambassadors, the volunteers who welcome new members, show up at ribbon cuttings and make sure no one feels like a stranger. He also leads Rowlett Young Professionals, the Chamber's group for the next generation of local business owners and leaders. Under his leadership the group has grown, giving more young professionals a place to find their footing and their people.

What sets Chris apart is how often he turns a conversation into a connection. He introduces people who should know each other, follows up and helps where he can, all with the goal of seeing other local businesses succeed.

This week, Dave Albert, owner of It's Good Marketing and a fellow Chamber member, wrote in to say thank you. Chris helped him grow his business this year, Dave says, one business owner to another, and the countless things Chris does for the community and the Chamber are what make him such a special citizen of Rowlett.

"I am honored to have him as a friend and mentor in my life," Dave wrote. "He makes Rowlett shine a little more than it already does!"

If Chris has helped you too, or you've met him at a Chamber event, take a minute this week to tell him thanks. And if someone in Rowlett has made a difference for you, we'd love to hear about them.
